list_giveaways.description: List the game giveaways Barter.vg has recorded, newest first: free keys, games to add to an account for free, limited and expiring keys and more, on Steam, Epic, GOG, itch.io and other platforms. Narrow by kind and platform, or to those newer than the last one seen, for a workflow that announces new ones.

list_offers.description: List the trade offers a Barter.vg trader has sent and received, most recently changed first, with the other trader, each side's status and whose move it is. Narrow to sent or received offers, to those waiting on the trader or on the other side, or to those changed since a time, for a workflow that reacts to new offers.

description: Read Barter.vg, where Steam game traders list what they have to trade and what they want. Look up a game's prices, reviews, bundle and giveaway history and the traders who have or want it; a trader's profile and their tradables, wishlist, library and blacklist; the games two traders could swap; a trader's offers and what is in each; and the giveaways and bundles Barter.vg tracks. No account or API key is needed. Barter.vg's terms allow its data for personal, non-commercial use, at up to 240 requests an hour shared by everyone on Lodol.
